entries.Cancel Command: The `roundfix cancel <slug> --reason <text>` command that retires an active Spec which will not be delivered: it writes an Archive Record with the disposition `cancelled`, performs Source Return and removes the Spec folder, which stays in Git at `source_revision`. It refuses while an Active Run or an unfinished Delivery Queue item holds the Spec or an active Spec requires it, never changes a Task status and never commits (ADR-0262). _Avoid_: Delete command, abandon, archive override
entries.Source Return: The Cancel Command's hand-back of a cancelled Spec's adopted sources: a Backlog Entry returns to `docs/backlog/` with `status: open` and no Spec, a Finding returns to `docs/findings/` with `status: pending` and a dated addendum, and every other byte is kept. Other adopted sources stay in Git with the folder (ADR-0262). _Avoid_: Unadoption, restore, re-triage
entries.Archive Record: The small `<slug>.md` record an archive leaves under the resolved archive root: a file named `NNNN-<slug>.md` whose front matter declares `roundfix/archive-record/v1`; any other Markdown file in that root is not a record. It carries the disposition, QA Report and verdict, promoted references, `source_revision` and, once the delivery pull request is open, `pull_request`; the removed Spec folder stays recoverable in Git at that revision, after a squash merge through Source Revision Recovery. The History Sanitize Command also writes one for a Legacy Archive Folder; a folder without a QA Report receives the disposition `no-qa`, while a folder whose newest QA Report failed without an override receives `failed-qa` and keeps that verdict and report name. `failed-qa` is never a pass or an override (ADR-0248, ADR-0251, ADR-0260, ADR-0261). A cancelled Spec's record has the disposition `cancelled` and carries `cancel_reason`, `completed_tasks`, `pending_tasks` and `returned_sources`; only its listed completed Tasks count as completed (ADR-0262). _Avoid_: Archive folder, archive log, copied Spec
entries.Supersession: A durable lifecycle record that names the Spec which delivered another Spec's content. The Archive Command accepts it as proof of completion for the superseded Spec when that Spec has no Task Graph. A cancelled Spec never delivers another Spec's content (ADR-0262). _Avoid_: Replacement, duplicate, hand-written disposition
entries.Prerequisite Spec: A Spec another Spec names in its Task Graph as `requires`; the queue owner does not start the dependent item until each prerequisite is merged into the default branch (ADR-0193). A cancelled Spec's record never meets a prerequisite (ADR-0262). _Avoid_: Queue order, dependency Task
entries.Delivery Retry: The explicit act that returns one parked Delivery Queue item to the stage supported by its recorded evidence and hands it to a live or newly started queue owner. It may perform Task Carry-Forward from every Run of the item's Spec, newest first, and is never automatic. It refuses a Spec whose Archive Record is `cancelled` (ADR-0262). _Avoid_: Resume Command, automatic retry, replay
